मुखकर्णी

MUKHAKARṆĪ . A follower of subrahmaṇya. (Śloka 29, Chapter 46, śalya Parva).

मुखमण्डिका

MUKHAMAṆḌIKĀ . One of the evil spirits tormenting infants. This is called diti also. (Śloka 30, Chapter 23, Vana Parva).

मुखर

MUKHARA . A serpent of the family of kaśyapa. (Śloka 16, Chapter 103, Udyoga Parva).

मुखसेचक

MUKHASECAKA . A serpent born of the family of dhṛtarāṣṭra. This serpent was burnt to death at the sarpasatra of janamejaya. (Ādi Parva, Chapter 47, Śloka 16).
